predecessor_decision: PNIR rejected after failing the disjoint-interval gate
query_text: a vehicle, pedestrian, or cyclist entering the ego vehicle's path from outside the driving corridor

candidate.name: Density-Adaptive Stratified Retrieval
selection_rule: For population n and budget B, generate the full greedy CLIP temporal-NMS ranking with radius 10.
Partition the timeline into M=min(n,max(B,round(1.5*B))) equal contiguous cells.
Take the highest-CLIP unit in every nonempty cell and sort cell winners by descending CLIP score.
Select the first k distinct NMS units, then fill to B from cell winners, then from the NMS ranking if overlap leaves a deficit.
candidate.selection_disclosure: The radius, 1.5 cell multiplier, and constant 8 were selected after opening dataset3, realcartest_2000_3200, and realcartest_0_1570.

comparators.arc_shared_k3: ARC refinement threshold 0.4, five seeds, exact B calls, shared K3
comparators.arc_native_descriptive: ARC native broad intervals, excluded from the primary fairness gate

decision_rule.event_rich_primary: On realcartest_3200_3830, DASR F1-AUC must strictly exceed ARC-shared-K3, CLIP, and NMS-h10.
decision_rule.sparse_directional: On realcartest_1630_2000, DASR F1-AUC must be no lower than ARC-shared-K3; ties are not treated as evidence of superiority.
decision_rule.macro_primary: Across the two intervals, unweighted mean DASR F1-AUC must strictly exceed unweighted mean ARC-shared-K3 F1-AUC.
decision_rule.fairness: Every primary method must use exactly B unique oracle observations and the identical shared materializer/evaluator.
decision_rule.pass: event-rich primary, sparse directional, macro primary, and fairness all hold
decision_rule.failure_action: Reject the confirmatory DASR claim. Do not alter constants using either interval and call it confirmed.

claim_limit: A pass establishes a reproducible advantage over exact-call shared-K3 ARC on this VLM-defined pseudo-oracle benchmark family. The final intervals are disjoint but share the realcartest source; human-ground-truth and broad cross-dataset generalization remain unresolved.
